canonical_title: RUM Group signs $13.7B six-year GPU services contract with US cloud customer
aliases: Rumble Northern Data Maysville GPU contract
Quake AI Maysville cloud customer contract
treatment: Treat as a signed AI-infrastructure services contract, not as delivered capacity or financed buildout. Reinclude only for customer identification, financing closure, named GPU generation/capacity, construction or delivery milestones, material contract amendment, or evidence that the third tranche becomes binding.
known_facts: RUM Group disclosed a six-year commercial agreement with an unaffiliated U.S.-based cloud customer for GPU services at its Maysville, Georgia site, which is still under development.
The total order value is approximately $13.7 billion across three tranches; the third tranche is contingent on customer approval of the proposed delivery date.
The customer is eligible for a warrant covering up to 50,808,408 Class A shares at a $0.01 exercise price, with vesting tied to purchases and potential expansion agreements.
RUM Group disclosed that it does not currently have the financing needed to fulfill the contract and expects to raise substantial debt and/or equity capital.
RUM Group was formed after Rumble closed its acquisition of Northern Data and operates its AI-infrastructure business as Quake AI.
reinclude_only_if: The unnamed cloud customer is identified or independently confirmed.
RUM Group closes material debt/equity financing required to fulfill the contract.
GPU generation, GPU count, MW capacity, or delivery schedule is formally disclosed.
The third tranche becomes binding or a material expansion agreement is signed.
A major construction, energization, or service-delivery milestone occurs at Maysville.
notes: The agreement is signed, but fulfillment remains capital-intensive and financing is not yet secured; do not equate $13.7B order value with current revenue or delivered compute capacity.
